title: Fantastic tour
text:
We booked through a small office in Sevilla and the whole process was smooth and friendly. 

Our guide, Marta, was incredibly passionate and gave us a deeper understanding of the building’s unique blend of Christian and Islamic history. Her storytelling really brought the place to life.

Having that one-on-one experience made a huge difference. Highly recommended if you want something a little more meaningful than the usual tourist rush.
author: mar_ajos_s590

title: Great tour
text:
The Seville Cathedral was high on our list, but we didn’t realize how busy it would be. Tickets were sold out everywhere, and we were honestly about to give up. That’s when we stumbled upon a little place  near the Catedral. The guy working there was so friendly and somehow worked his magic to get us into a private tour.

Our guide, was fantastic—super knowledgeable and easy to talk to. We learned so much, and having the tour just for us made it feel really personal and special. It turned out to be one of the best experiences of our entire trip.

Truly grateful for the help and the unforgettab
author: eloybullon

title: Priceless help
text:
We were in Seville a few weeks ago, my husband wanted to visit the Cathedral as we were told a lot about it and my husband has Muslim origins. We didn't think it would be high season and when we arrived we saw that it was all sold out. Thank God, we stumbled upon a store very close to the cathedral called Tickets4U. The lovely boy treated us super well and also got us tickets almost magically when no one had. 

It was very worth doing the private tour, the Melissa guide was lovely too and gave us a lot of interesting information. 

Thank you both again!!
author: Freedom63204691429

title: Amazing Cathedral Tour
text: We had a private tour of the Cathedral with Javi. It was definitely worth doing a private tour of this monument. It was also the only way we could get tickets, as they were sold out due to high demand. Absolutely worth it!
